snip.t: The most common schwannomas, termed vestibular schwannomas or acoustic neuromas, arise from the vestibular portion of the eighth cranial nerve and account for approximately 9% of primary brain tumors.
Presents with tinnitus + hearing loss ("acoustic neuroma" = misnomer — not acoustic nerve, not a neuroma)
